description: The context cold-storage tier - unbounded lifetime history by year, search-only, with optional period digests that link to (never replace) the raw episodes.
title: Archive

description: The context entry tier - the newest session summaries, the two newest of which load at session start.
title: Current Context

description: Session context: the tiered cascade of session summaries (Current to Recent to Archive) that carries what happened across working sessions. The gist grain of context memory; recall is importance-aware.
title: Context

description: The context mid tier - recent session summaries one step back from the entry tier, reached on request and ranked by recency, importance, and relevance.
title: Recent Context

description: Prospective memory: important dates, deadlines, anniversaries, and recurring events. Future-facing reference, one table row per date.
title: Dates

description: Reflective record of significant decisions, one file per decision, with context, alternatives, outcomes, and lessons.
title: Decisions

description: Registry of organizations in the owner's personal life that are not their own ventures, one file per organization.
title: Organizations

description: Registry of the people in the owner's personal orbit, one Biography-depth file per person.
title: People

description: Registry of places of personal significance to the owner, one file per place.
title: Places

description: Semantic memory: durable facts about the people, organizations, and places in the owner's personal world, kept as per-entry collections.
title: Entities

description: The atomic grain of context memory: discrete, dated events and experiences worth remembering on their own, distinct from session context, decisions, and future dates.
title: Events

description: Reflective synthesis of higher-order observations about the owner's outside world, distilled from context and entity memory.
title: Insights

description: Working memory: the chronological capture stream where observations, events, and open threads land first, before they promote to a collection or age out. Newest first; read at session start.
title: Memory Log

description: The continuity layer, organized by kind of memory: working (Log), context (session summaries and events), semantic (Entities), reflective (Decisions and Insights), and prospective (Dates). It records what happened and the owner's outside world, with capture-time importance, recency-importance-relevance retrieval, reflection, and bitemporal provenance. Who the owner IS lives in Profile, never here.
title: Memory - Folder Information

description: The owner's life facts and life story: name, contact, location, work, education, family, formative years, key events, and the McAdams narrative themes that give the facts meaning.
title: Biography

description: The owner's stable personal financial picture and money-management self: financial situation, assets and liabilities, insurance, risk posture, money style, financial goals, and the existence and location of legal and estate documents. Sensitive; records the picture and pointers, never secret numbers.
title: Finances

description: The dynamic layer: the owner's current priorities, how to help right now, routines, current life chapter, and what is on the horizon. Changes often; trust it over older notes and refresh it on use.
title: Focus

description: The owner's enduring aspirations and direction: the stable, long-horizon goals that define what they are working toward, distinct from this week's priorities.
title: Goals

description: Stable health attributes and accessibility needs that affect how to help. For awareness, not diagnostic use; surfaced only when directly relevant. Conditions are isolated as their own sensitive entries.
title: Health

description: How the owner lives day to day: the stable patterns of sleep, diet, exercise, substances, daily rhythm, rituals, living environment, and recreation. The enduring counterpart to the dynamic Focus layer.
title: Lifestyle

description: How the owner thinks, focuses, feels, works, learns, and behaves under pressure: personality typing, Big Five with BFI-2 facets, temperament, cognitive/working/learning style, emotional and social style, strengths, blind spots, and behavior under pressure.
title: Personality

description: The owner's interests, tastes, media, food and lifestyle, tools, aesthetics, and dislikes: the topical likes that personalize suggestions, distinct from how they like to be worked with (Working Style) and their competencies (Skills).
title: Preferences

description: Who the owner is, in twelve facets: eleven of the stable self, from Working Style and Biography to Finances and Health, and the dynamic Focus layer. The foundation for personalized, contextually appropriate help, and how it is read and written with discretion.
title: Profile - Folder Information

description: The owner's relational self and social world: family and household structure, the roles they hold, their social network, attachment and relational style, and key contacts. The individual people themselves live in Memory; this holds the relational self.
title: Relationships

description: The owner's competencies and the per-domain expertise map that calibrates how much to explain: skip the basics where the owner is expert, define terms where they are new.
title: Skills

description: What the owner cares about and how they decide what is right: core values, orientation axes, life philosophy, ethics, motivation, purpose, role models, and what they stand for and against, plus held beliefs as sensitive entries.
title: Values

description: How the owner likes to work with anyone who works with them, a person or an AI: how to address them, the do's, don'ts, tone, length, and format rules followed in every reply, plus communication, terminology, feedback, and decision style. The facet acted on most.
title: Working Style
